item.text:
The likely fault is in [VoiceBroadcastPreRecordingPip.tsx](/app/src/voice-broadcast/components/molecules/VoiceBroadcastPreRecordingPip.tsx:31). It passes `start` directly to “Go live,” with no pending guard or disabled state, so rapid clicks or key activations can call it more than once before the view is dismissed. The microphone handler also accepts activations while the menu is open. Device selection already closes the menu and updates the label through `useAudioDeviceSelection`, but the local callback allows `null` even though `setDevice` requires a device.

[Existing component tests](/app/test/voice-broadcast/components/molecules/VoiceBroadcastPreRecordingPip-test.tsx:96) cover one menu opening and selection. They do not check repeated activation, pending start resolution or rejection, or close behavior. The fix should guard `start` synchronously, render “Go live” disabled until the attempt completes, ignore menu activations while open, and verify selection and dismissal transitions.

I did not edit source or tests: the assigned fault-localization role explicitly prohibits those changes. The diagnosis is recorded in [.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md).
